Class MudTablePageBase<TItem, TFilter, TOrdering>

Namespace
NuvTools.AspNetCore.Blazor.MudBlazor.Components
Assembly
NuvTools.AspNetCore.Blazor.MudBlazor.dll

Abstract base class for pages with server-side paged lists using MudBlazor MudTable.

public abstract class MudTablePageBase<TItem, TFilter, TOrdering> : ComponentBase, IComponent, IHandleEvent, IHandleAfterRender where TFilter : PagingFilter<TOrdering> where TOrdering : struct, Enum

Type Parameters

TItem

The type of DTO displayed in the table.

TFilter

The filter type that inherits from PagingFilter<T>.

TOrdering

The enum type for sorting options.

Examples

public class UserListPage : MudTablePageBase<UserDto, UserFilter, UserSortColumn>
{
    [Inject] private IUserService UserService { get; set; } = default!;

    protected override string SessionStorageKey => "user-list-filter";

    protected override UserFilter CreateDefaultFilter() => new()
    {
        SortColumn = UserSortColumn.Name,
        PageSize = 25
    };

    protected override async Task<IResult<PagingWithEnumerableList<UserDto>>> FetchDataAsync(
        UserFilter filter, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        return await UserService.GetUsersAsync(filter, cancellationToken);
    }

    protected override UserSortColumn MapSortLabelToOrdering(string sortLabel)
    {
        return Enum.Parse<UserSortColumn>(sortLabel);
    }
}

Remarks

This base class provides:

  • Session storage persistence for filter state
  • Integration with ILoadingService for loading indicators
  • MudTable server-side data binding
  • Sort direction mapping between NuvTools and MudBlazor
  • Support for SkipCount to avoid expensive COUNT queries on large datasets
